homeScreen.title: Add {{appName}} to your Home Screen
homeScreen.subtitle: Open it full-screen from your phone, without the browser bar.
homeScreen.iosTitle: Add to Home Screen on iPhone or iPad
homeScreen.iosStep1: In Safari, tap the Share button: the square with an arrow pointing up.
homeScreen.iosStep2: Scroll down the list and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
homeScreen.iosStep3: Tap 'Add'. The app icon appears on your Home Screen.
homeScreen.iosNote: Use Safari. Other browsers on iPhone cannot add a website to the Home Screen.
homeScreen.androidTitle: Add to Home Screen on Android
homeScreen.androidStep1: Open the browser menu: the three dots standing at the top right.
homeScreen.androidStep3: Tap 'Install' or 'Add'. The app icon appears on your Home Screen.
homeScreen.androidNote: The wording differs a little between browsers and phone brands.

auth.title: Loan Management
auth.subtitle: Sign in with your staff account to continue.
auth.lockedFailedAttempts: This account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts.
auth.lockedIdle: This account is locked because it has not signed in for a long time.
auth.lockedContactAdmin: Ask an ADMIN to unlock it. Once unlocked, the system emails a link so you can choose a new password.
auth.expiredInfo: This password has passed the monthly limit, so the session was refused. Choose a new one below — it cannot repeat any password this account has already used.
auth.forgotInfo: Enter the email address on your staff account and we send a 6-digit code.
auth.codeInfo: Type the 6-digit code we just emailed. It expires shortly and works once.
auth.resetInfo: This link works once. Pick a password that meets the rules below.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
auth.resetDone: Password updated — sign in with your new password.
auth.resetNoToken: This page needs a reset link. Request a new code.

users.info: Staff accounts control who can make and approve movements. Deleting an account is reversible and never erases its audit trail or loan history.
users.emailHelper: Used for notifications and password resets.
users.deleted: Account deleted — it can be restored from the deleted list.
users.confirmDelete: Delete {{username}}? The account stops signing in but all history is kept.
users.unlockLinkSent: A link to choose a new password was emailed to the account holder.
users.lockFailedAttempts: Locked since {{since}} after too many failed sign-in attempts.
users.lockIdle: Locked since {{since}} because the account has not signed in for a long time.
users.resetSent: Password reset link sent — it expires in the time stated in the email.

profile.info: This is your own account. You can correct your name, email and photo here; role and account status stay with an administrator.
profile.emailHelper: Changing the email makes it unverified again until an administrator confirms the new address.
profile.passwordExpired: Your password has passed the monthly limit. Change it below — your next sign-in will be refused until you do.
profile.passwordExpiringSoon: Your password must be replaced in {{days}} day(s).
profile.passwordHistoryHint: A new password cannot repeat any password this account has already used.
profile.passwordInfo: Confirm your current password first. Afterwards every other session ends and you must sign in again.
profile.passwordDone: Password updated — all other sessions have ended.

manual.languageNote: This manual exists in two editions, English and Thai, with the same chapter numbers. Menu, button and error names are quoted from the English interface.

kyc.checklistSatisfied: All required evidence is present. This set can be submitted for verification.

type.SELFIE_WITH_ID: Photo of the customer with their ID

kyc.fileTooLarge: This image is larger than the configured limit of {{size}} KB.
kyc.fileHint: Images only ({{types}}). Maximum {{size}} KB per file and {{files}} file(s) per request — configured in System Configuration.
kyc.draw: Or draw the customer signature here
kyc.imageError: The image could not be loaded
kyc.deleteConfirm: Delete {{type}} “{{file}}”? The stored image is removed and the audit trail records the deletion.
kyc.submitInfo: Submitting locks this evidence set for review. A different staff member must verify it.
kyc.verifyInfo: You confirm that the customer's identity matches this evidence. The policy applied is stored with the result.
kyc.reopenInfo: Only an admin can reopen a VERIFIED KYC, for example when the policy or the evidence changes.
kyc.makerChecker: Maker-checker: the person who submitted or uploaded this evidence cannot verify it.
kyc.youSubmitted: You submitted this KYC — another checker must verify it.
kyc.youUploaded: You uploaded part of this evidence — another checker must verify it.
kyc.rejectInfo: Rejecting sends the file back to the maker with your reason recorded.
kyc.gateBlocked: Disbursement is blocked until this KYC is VERIFIED.
kyc.gateOpen: KYC is VERIFIED — this customer can receive a loan disbursement.
kyc.gateDisabled: The disbursement gate is currently off in System Configuration.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.info: Where this customer's money actually travels. Registering an account changes no KYC status — what makes it trustworthy is the proof image filed against it below.
bank.closeInfo: Closing stops future money going to this account. Loans already paid into it keep pointing at this record.
bank.proofInfo: An image per account showing the number really belongs to this customer. It stays outside the KYC pipeline, so uploading a new proof never sends a verified customer back to review.
bank.maskInfo: The full number is stored so a transfer can be reconciled against it, but every screen, letter and audit entry shows only the last digits.
bank.needAccountFirst: Register an active account first — a proof has to name the account it documents.

evidence.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{file}}”? The stored image is removed and the audit trail records the deletion.
evidence.fileHint: Images only ({{types}}). Maximum {{size}} KB per file and {{files}} file(s) per request — configured in System Configuration.
evidence.fileTooLarge: This image is larger than the configured limit of {{size}} KB.
evidence.imageError: The image could not be loaded

disbursement.bankInfo: Money is transferred to a registered account, so the number on the slip is the number on file — never one typed into a note. {{count}} active account(s) for this customer.
disbursement.cashInfo: Cash needs no account. File the signed receipt afterwards so the paper proof sits next to the ledger entry.
disbursement.channelInfo: Recording how the money was handed over is optional here — it can be set later on the loan's Disbursement tab.
disbursement.info: The loan and its disbursement entry are booked when the loan is created. This tab records which channel the money went through and files the transfer slip or cash receipt as proof.
disbursement.pickAccount: Choose the account the money was sent to.
disbursement.slipInfo: Upload the bank slip or the cash receipt after the money moves. A slip moves no balance and needs no approval; correcting one is a delete plus a new upload.

products.name: Name
products.interestInfo: The interest basis decides what is booked at disbursement: a flat product bills the whole term in one lump, a declining-balance product bills one period at a time on the principal still owed.
products.unitHint: Conversions: 1 year = 12 months, 1 month = 30 days, 1 week = 7 days.
products.interestFlat: Flat: the whole-term interest is booked as one lump at disbursement.
products.interestDeclining: Declining balance: equal principal each period, interest only on what is still owed.
products.penaltyEnabled: Charge a penalty when a payment is late
products.saved: Product updated. Existing loans keep their own snapshot.
products.updatedLoans: New loans use these terms immediately.
products.penaltyPercentDisplay: Penalty {{rate}}% per {{unit}} of the overdue amount
products.earlySettlementFeePercentHelper: Charged when the customer pays off the whole debt before the last instalment falls due. 0 = no fee. Loans already disbursed keep the rate they were signed with.

loans.search: Search loan no / customer / national ID
loans.newDialog: New Loan — creates and posts the disbursement
loans.kycGate: Only a customer whose KYC is VERIFIED can receive a disbursement.
loans.aggregates: All loans in this filter — principal {{principal}} · interest {{interest}} · penalty {{penalty}} · outstanding {{total}}
loans.termOverride: Term (leave empty for the product default)
loans.interestPreviewDeclining: Interest over {{periods}} period(s): {{interest}} — charged period by period as the balance falls
loans.decliningAtDisbursement: Only period 1 ({{first}}) is booked now, so the total at disbursement is {{total}}

loanDetail.allocationPreview: Payment Allocation Preview (sequential: Penalty → Past Interest → Past Principal)
loanDetail.overpayment: Overpayment of {{amount}} would go to customer credit.

payments.pendingHint: The request remains pending until a different authorized checker verifies receipt. Posted transactions alone change outstanding.
payments.proposedAllocation: Proposed allocation — edit only when an authorized override is needed
payments.overMaxPayable: {{requested}} is above the {{max}} due today — bring the difference as a deposit to credit instead.
payments.depositHint: A deposit is booked against no debt: the whole amount lands in the customer's credit, and the system auto-debits it when the instalment falls due.

approvals.subject: Subject
approvals.makerBlocked: Created by you — maker cannot approve own request
approvals.approvalInfo: Approval changes a transaction to APPROVED; it does not post it. Financial balances change only after a separate successful POST.
approvals.selectAll: Select every approval you can decide
approvals.bulkInfo: Each item is decided by the same maker-checker rules. An item that cannot move is reported with its reason and stays pending.
approvals.interestRunInfo: One charge per loan per run, priced on the principal outstanding now. A period already billed or already waiting in this queue is never billed twice, and you cannot approve a charge you created yourself.
approvals.interestAccrued: {{charges}} interest charge(s) submitted for approval, total {{amount}}

transactions.info: Pending financial transactions require approval. Posting is a separate atomic operation; posted history is never edited.
transactions.reversalInfo: Reversal components are selected by the system in the original allocation order after approval.
transactions.postWarning: Posting permanently changes the loan balance. Verify the source documents before confirming.
transactions.reverseWarning: Reversal is a separate immutable transaction and does not delete the original ledger entry.

settlements.feeApplies: Paying off before the last instalment falls due costs {{percent}}% of the principal still outstanding ({{principal}}), so the early-settlement fee is {{fee}}. It is billed as its own penalty transaction with its own approval, and must be posted before the settlement payment.
settlements.feeNone: No early-settlement fee on this payoff: {{reason}}
settlements.feeNoneTermReached: every instalment of this loan has already fallen due
settlements.paymentCeiling: This payment may not exceed {{agreed}} agreed + {{fee}} early-settlement fee = {{total}}. The fee must be approved and posted first.
settlements.feeRuleNone: No early-settlement fee: closing this loan ahead of schedule costs nothing extra.
settlements.feeRuleEarly: Early-settlement fee {{percent}}% of the principal still owed: closing today costs {{fee}}, so the total to hand over is {{total}}.
settlements.feeRuleAtTermEnd: This loan has reached its final instalment, so closing it now carries no early-settlement fee.
settlements.waiverInfo: The full agreed settlement amount must first be paid and posted. Any posted payment reversals reduce the amount counted.
settlements.info: An agreement does not change outstanding. Its payment and any shortfall waiver are separate financial transactions subject to posting and approval.
settlements.waiveWarning: Only the residual outstanding balance may be waived, and only after posted settlement payments equal the full agreed amount.

credits.info: Credit is accrued only from posted overpayments and is applied to a future payment request with a ledger entry.

reconciliation.info: Reconciliation compares operational balances with posted transaction lines. Mismatches are recorded and must be resolved through an approved adjustment; this process never edits balances.

reports.info: Monthly summary is calculated only from posted ledger activity. Growth compares each month with the previous month (MoM) and the same month last year (YoY).
reports.outstandingCheck: Closing from ledger {{ledger}} · loan book {{loanBook}} · loans opened in window {{loansOpened}}
reports.noData: No posted activity in this window
reports.clickMonth: Select a month in a chart to filter the table below.

quickOpen.label: Quick search
quickOpen.placeholder: Search customer name, customer number or loan number

admin.info: These thresholds apply globally to every financial approval workflow. Existing workflows retain their recorded approval steps.
admin.upTo: Up to {{amount}}: Maker → Checker. Above this through {{headAmount}}: Head approval is added. Above that: Admin final approval is added.

password.title: Password policy
password.info: These rules apply to every new password — account creation, admin resets and self-service resets. They take effect on the next request, without a server restart.
password.order: Minimum length cannot exceed the maximum.
password.rules: At least one character rule must stay on.
password.readOnly: Only an admin can change the password policy.

security.title: Account security policy
security.info: These rules decide when the system locks an account by itself and when a password must be replaced. They take effect on the next request, without a server restart. Setting a number to 0 switches that one rule off.
security.maxFailedHelper: Consecutive failed sign-in attempts that lock the account. 0 = never lock on failures.
security.idleLockDays: Days without a sign-in before locking
security.idleLockHelper: An account that has not signed in for this many days is locked. 0 = accounts never expire.
security.idleLockJobHelper: Off by default. A failed sign-in always applies the rule immediately; the job only marks idle accounts in the database before anyone tries to sign in.
security.passwordMaxAgeHelper: After this many days the owner must set a new password before using the system. 0 = passwords never expire.
security.passwordHistoryCount: Passwords that may not be reused
security.passwordHistoryHelper: How many previous passwords a new one is compared against. 0 = only the current password.
security.applyToAdminHelper: When off, admins skip the idle lock and the expiry gate so a branch can never lock itself out of user management.
security.range: {{field}} must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
security.warnAfterAge: The warning must come before the password expires — keep it at or below the validity in days.
security.readOnly: Only an admin can change the account security policy.

avatar.title: User photo policy
avatar.info: Staff photos are stored as images in the database, exactly like KYC evidence, and are used only for display.
avatar.imageOnly: Image formats only — PDF and other file types are rejected by the server.
avatar.mimeRequired: Keep at least one image format enabled.
avatar.readOnly: Only an admin can change the photo policy.

kyc.title: KYC policy
kyc.info: These settings govern every KYC upload and the loan disbursement gate. They take effect on the next request, without a server restart.
kyc.requireSelfieWithId: Require a photo of the customer holding their ID
kyc.expiryWarningDays: Warn when a document expires within (days)
kyc.blockDisbursementUntilVerified: Block loan disbursement until KYC is VERIFIED
kyc.reverifyOnDocumentChange: Return to PENDING when verified evidence changes
kyc.readOnly: Only an admin can change the KYC policy.
kyc.imageOnly: Image formats only — PDF and other file types are rejected by the server.
kyc.identitySubset: Identity documents accepted must be one of the document types accepted.

payment.title: Repayment collection policy
payment.info: Staff may only collect an instalment that has already arrived, so money brought early is booked as customer credit instead. The auto-debit job then settles each instalment from that credit before it falls due. Changes take effect on the next run, without restarting the server.
payment.enabled: Let the system auto-debit instalments from customer credit
payment.leadDays: Auto-debit this many days before the due date
payment.leadDaysHelper: 0 collects only instalments that have already arrived.
payment.leadDaysRange: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to {{max}}.
payment.readOnly: Only an admin can change the collection policy.
payment.previewInfo: Asks the server what it would debit across the active loans. It creates nothing and moves no money.
payment.previewNone: Nothing would be debited — {{scanned}} active loan(s) checked.
payment.previewSummary: {{total}} instalment(s) would be debited, {{amount}} in total, from {{scanned}} active loan(s).
payment.previewWhileOff: The switch is off, so none of these is debited by itself.

collateral.title: Collateral policy
collateral.info: These rules decide when pledged property is enough cover for a loan, and therefore when a hardship addendum can be raised at all. They are read every time a restructure is checked, so a change takes effect on the next request without restarting the server.
collateral.minCoverage: Minimum cover (percent of what is owed)
collateral.minCoverageHelper: 0 removes the cover floor entirely — pledged value no longer has to reach a percentage of the balance.
collateral.coverageRange: Enter a cover percent from 0 to {{max}}.
collateral.valuationAgeHelper: 0 means an appraisal never expires, however old it is.
collateral.valuationAgeRange: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to {{max}}.
collateral.requirePledge: Refuse a hardship addendum when nothing is pledged
collateral.readOnly: Only an admin can change the collateral policy.

evidence.title: Evidence upload policy
evidence.info: The rules every bank account proof and disbursement slip is checked against. They cover financial evidence only — identity paperwork follows the KYC policy. Read on every upload, so a change takes effect on the next request without restarting the server.
evidence.sizeRange: Enter a whole number of KB from 1 to {{max}}.
evidence.perRequestRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
evidence.needMimeType: At least one image type has to stay allowed.
evidence.maxTotalBytesPerOwner: Evidence storage per customer or loan (MB)
evidence.quotaHelper: The ceiling applies to each owner separately: one customer's proofs and one loan's slips each get this much room.
evidence.quotaTooSmall: The quota has to fit at least one image of the maximum size.
evidence.readOnly: Only an admin can change the evidence policy.

parties.info: Everyone standing behind this loan: guarantors and any payer who takes over from the borrower. Each one is judged on the identity check they complete for THIS loan — being verified on another loan years ago proves nothing here.
parties.addDialog: Name a guarantor or a payer
parties.none: No guarantor or payer has been named on this loan.
parties.releaseInfo: Releasing takes their promise away from the loan. The record stays for audit. Only a head approver or an admin may do it.
parties.kycRule: They must complete an identity check for this loan before a hardship addendum can rely on them.
parties.isBorrower: The borrower cannot replace themselves as payer

collateral.info: Property pledged against this loan. Cover is the appraised value of pledges that are still in date, measured against what is still owed. The floor and the age limit are set by the admin.
collateral.coveragePercent: Pledges cover {{percent}}% of the balance; {{required}}% is required.
collateral.coverageAmounts: {{pledged}} pledged item(s) counted · {{counted}} against {{outstanding}} still owed.
collateral.valuationAge: Oldest appraisal is {{oldest}}; anything older than {{max}} day(s) no longer counts.
collateral.valuationAgeNever: Appraisals never expire under this policy; the oldest on file is {{oldest}}.
collateral.releaseInfo: A released item stops counting as cover but stays on the record. Only a head approver or an admin may do it.
collateral.releaseReason: Why is the pledge being released
collateral.releaseWouldBreak: The loan is already short of cover — releasing this makes it worse.
collateral.none: Nothing has been pledged against this loan.

restructure.info: A borrower who can no longer pay as contracted gets a written addendum: a lower rate, a longer term, a replacement payer, relief of the interest that has piled up, or any mix of them. Approval alone changes nothing — an operator applies the paper afterwards, and relief reaches the ledger only as a waiver that is approved and posted in its own right.
restructure.bookInfo: Every hardship addendum in the book. Filter by status, open the loan to read the paper, then apply what has been approved.
restructure.reasonHelper: What happened, and why the terms now in force cannot be met
restructure.rateHelper: A hardship rate must be below {{rate}}% per {{unit}}.
restructure.termHelper: Must be longer than {{months}} month(s) and no more than {{max}}.
restructure.noPayerCandidates: No guarantor or payer is engaged on this loan yet — add one on the guarantors tab first.
restructure.payerKyc: That payer's identity check is not verified for this loan yet.
restructure.reliefHelper: Up to {{amount}} of accrued, unpaid interest can be relieved.
restructure.currentTerms: Now in force: {{rate}} · {{months}} month(s) · paid by {{payer}}
restructure.coverageOk: Security covers {{percent}}% of what is owed.
restructure.coverageBroken: Security does not meet the policy
restructure.approvalFloor: Every addendum needs a checker and a head approver, and an admin joins above the head threshold. Whoever drafts it cannot approve it.
restructure.createdNote: Addendum {{requestNo}} is on file and waiting for approval.
restructure.applied: Addendum {{requestNo}} is in force; the schedule now follows the new terms.
restructure.appliedWithRelief: Addendum {{requestNo}} is in force. The relief is drafted as waiver {{waiver}} and must still be approved and posted separately.
restructure.none: No hardship addendum has been raised on this loan.
restructure.coverageAtSubmission: Security at the time of filing covered {{percent}}% of the {{required}}% required.
restructure.needReason: Describe the hardship in at least 10 characters.
restructure.rateNotLower: The new rate must be lower than the rate in force.
restructure.needTerm: Enter the new term as whole months.
restructure.termNotLonger: An extended term must be longer than the term in force.
restructure.termTooLong: A restructured term cannot pass {{max}} months.
restructure.needPayer: Choose who takes over as payer.
restructure.needRelief: Enter how much interest to relieve.
restructure.reliefTooBig: Relief cannot exceed the interest accrued and unpaid.

schedule.info: Calculated from posted transactions — this page never changes the ledger.
schedule.accrueInfo: Creates a PENALTY transaction that must be approved and posted — the balance does not move by itself.
schedule.accrueDisabled: This loan has no penalty policy
schedule.interestAccrueInfo: Creates an INTEREST ACCRUAL for the period that has begun; it must be approved and posted before the balance moves.
schedule.interestAccrueNone: No interest period is ready to charge
schedule.interestAccrueDisabled: This loan bills interest as one flat lump, so there is nothing to charge per period
schedule.interestPerPeriodNote: Interest is charged period by period on the principal still outstanding
schedule.noPenalty: No penalty is charged on this product
schedule.noCredit: This customer has no credit balance
schedule.fifoNote: Payments clear the oldest period first (penalty, then interest, then principal).
